title: Style Packs, Templates, Renderer Profiles & Visual Variant Recipes
objective: Implement reusable style packs, appearance templates, palette/material sets, renderer/output profiles and deterministic visual-variation recipes over governed MCCS appearance workspaces without creating canonical identity, population truth, or renderer-specific authority.

scope.purpose: Extend the MCCS presentation stack with reusable style/template/profile primitives and deterministic visual-variation recipes while preserving owner-supplied entity/group identity and eligibility.
scope.completion_gate: Representative humanoid, nonhumanoid and owner-supplied group appearances can apply reusable style/template/profile/variant recipes deterministically with explicit compatibility and unresolved states, while preserving canonical identity, population, mechanics, asset and live-state authority.

selection_boundaries: MCCS-01, MCCS-03, MCCS-05, MCCS-06, MCCS-09, MCCS-11 and MCCS-13 are completed_verified foundations and are not reopened.
Fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.4 contains no MCCS-13-triggered rotation or interstitial override; reduced MCCS strict order therefore selects MCCS-16.
CAPP/PPIA retain renderer-neutral appearance authority; PAPT/PCA retain reusable character-asset, style-generation and local-production primitives.
MNCS supplies NPC/crowd/herd/group identities and eligibility; PCA supplies generic procedural substrate. MCCS-16 may produce visual variation only and never creates population truth.
Character/NPC/Creature/Species/Form owners retain canonical identity, mechanics and live-state truth; ARI/PCA retain generic resource identity, provenance, version and review authority.
Unsupported renderer/style/template/profile compatibility remains explicit and may not silently rewrite semantic appearance.
MCCS-16 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or authority exists until a later owner Continue.
ui-implementation and player-species remain independently governed and must be preserved exactly from fresh CURRENT.
next_action: Implement only the missing MCCS-16 style/template/profile/visual-variant production seam on the already-active Multiversal-app FIFO turn, then validate unchanged assertions on exact head.
